name: The Come-Up
premise: A faceless cinematic diary of building a life from scratch: one lesson a day from building an app, investing a first paycheck, and staying disciplined, illustrated with moody AI b-roll of a city at dawn, a desk, a gym, a train.
audience: 20-somethings who want to build something and are tired of hype
promise: One honest lesson a day from someone actually doing it
anchor: A recurring empty desk by a tall window over a waking city: a single lamp, a notebook, a cold coffee, rain on the glass; the camera always returns here
material: Tommy's real build-in-public progress, investing moves, habit streaks and setbacks
tone: quiet, honest, a little funny, never corporate
